title: AI News Daily — July 30, 2026
summary: The day's throughline was less about a single new model than about who pays for AI and who builds it: an influential argument that AI compute could get an order of magnitude more expensive collided with news that Google DeepMind dismantled its Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold team, Thinking Machines' co-founder left over unsustainable workload to join OpenAI, and Moonshot AI is chasing a $50 billion valuation on its way to a Hong Kong IPO.
